name: build-novel
description: Develop, revise, and prepare novels of any genre for publication, preserving the author's voice and reducing formulaic, AI-sounding prose.

interface.shortDescription: Write novels of any genre with your own voice
interface.longDescription: An author-led workflow for novels and series of any genre, from first ideas through drafting, revision, simulated reader panels, translation, and publication preparation. Helps preserve distinctive voices and reduce generic phrasing, repetitive patterns, and over-explanation that can make prose feel AI-generated, while respecting deliberate literary choices.
defaultPrompt: Help me develop a novel, asking one consequential question at a time and preserving my voice.
